_comment: Pass criteria for analyze_run.py and compare_runs.py. Set and commit these BEFORE testing; changing them after seeing results makes the evidence worthless.
_max_lost_caster_to_client: null: losses between the caster and ntrip_client (the vehicle's Wi-Fi, e.g. switching access points) are reported, not judged; they are the same with MAVROS. A number makes them a pass criterion.
